prompt_set_summary: Six original creature-trophy cutouts in the Aurelion Reach inventory language: a fired antler crownring, a peatglass crown-tooth, a crystalline facet pinion, a living heartgrain mantle, a three-gauge ironback plate, and a whalebone resonance bell. Each source was requested individually as one centered hand-painted strategy-game object with transparent padding, a strong 128px silhouette, controlled faction materials, no scene, no text, no characters, no logos, and no borrowed franchise design.
runtime_derivation: Trim transparent bounds, fit inside 112x112 without upscaling, center on a transparent 128x128 canvas, and strip ancillary metadata.

items.prompt_summary: Fired ivory ceramic antlers closing into a clinker-red crown ring with charcoal bindings and muted brass braces.
items.accessible_description: A wide scorched ring rises into paired branching ceramic antlers above ember-bright clinker seams.

items.prompt_summary: Broad black fang suspended inside a crescent peatglass-root frame with wet cords and two moon beads.
items.accessible_description: A single broad dark fang hangs inside a hooked crescent of wet roots, peatglass, and two round moon beads.

items.prompt_summary: Five translucent feather-prism facets locked around a compact white-gold noon disk.
items.accessible_description: Five long crystalline feather facets radiate asymmetrically from a bright circular sun setting.

items.prompt_summary: Broad shoulder mantle of overlapping heartwood plates, green living seams, and paired root clasps.
items.accessible_description: A broad layered bark mantle shows circular heartwood grain, glowing seams, and two pale root-clasp hooks.

items.prompt_summary: Curved black carapace plate with a bellhorn relief, three red gauges, brass braces, and one coolant tube.
items.accessible_description: A heavy curved black plate carries three unequal round gauges beside a raised horn and thick riveted brass bands.

items.prompt_summary: Pale whalebone bell beneath a bone crossbar, five saltglass chimes, dark tideglass clapper, and knotted cord.
items.accessible_description: A pierced whalebone bell hangs below a bone bar, flanked by five long saltglass chimes and a dark drop-shaped clapper.
